test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

The soldiers __are all on their toes and anxiously waiting__ for the orders to start marching towards the enemy.

options.text: all on their toes and anxiously dancing
all on their fingers and anxiously waiting

solution: The correct answer is '1' No substitution required.
